scope: Custom P-256 ECDSA signed manufacturer device-issuer credential
Separate P-256 signed calibration authority credential
Independent externally pinned root SHA-256 fingerprints
Issuer/subject, role, permission, organization and serial checks
limitations: Custom signed credential schema; not a full X.509 path builder
Pinning a root supplied inside the same evidence package does not establish external authenticity
External authentication boolean must come from an independent offline or institutional workflow and is not self-proving
Synthetic roots, valid signatures, or flags can never authorize physical ACT
Actual physical hardware and certified calibration records have not been acquired
